description: Stub ui_paste_files in evals/coder-desktop/host_driver/ui_host_stub.{h,c} to fix Linux link error.

steps.send: The Linux build of `evals/coder-desktop/host_driver` fails to link because `ui_paste_files` is referenced by `host.c` but missing from the headless UI host stub. Declare `int ui_paste_files(UiHost *h);` in `evals/coder-desktop/host_driver/ui_host_stub.h` and implement it returning `0` in `evals/coder-desktop/host_driver/ui_host_stub.c`. Verify with `cc -fsyntax-only evals/coder-desktop/host_driver/ui_host_stub.c`.
